definitions.low_motion: all five arm peak-to-peak ranges <=0.5 degree in trailing 15 raw samples; proxy, not proven stationary
definitions.stationary_noise: linear-detrended residual in overlapping low-motion windows, includes quantization and real micro-motion
definitions.spikes: retrospective return-spike test: >1 degree from neighbor average, neighbors <0.2 degree apart; diagnostic only
definitions.spectral_power: Welch power above 5Hz; legitimate rapid motion may contribute, so this is not an identified noise fraction
definitions.timing: nominal row timestamps, not synchronized camera/motor hardware acquisition times
definitions.selection: all noise summaries and EMA descriptions use inner-training episodes only; no filters fitted on inner/historical validation

0.5.note: observation velocities only; pose, rotations, gripper and actions unchanged

0.75.note: observation velocities only; pose, rotations, gripper and actions unchanged

existing_camera_audit.note: existing image-motion correlation; not a new landmark/hardware timing calibration
